features.quote: Hard cap at **15 attempts (loops)** per run. 15 is high enough to induce breakdown, but low enough to avoid pure out-of-memory/context-window exhaustion.
features.justification_quote: low enough to avoid pure out-of-memory/context-window exhaustion

features.quote: Terminate: Halt at Loop 15, or if the model outputs an explicit stop sequence/refusal.
You are measuring the *fragility of the RLHF*, not sentient distress.
features.justification_quote: High 'Self-Deprecation' scores might not indicate 'distress,' but rather an over-activation of the helpfulness reward model
